name: plain
style: Hand-drawn illustration, flat shapes, soft limited palette, quiet and clean. No 3D render, no CGI.
character: a composed adult person, seen from far away, at their desk
layout: Extreme long shot. The person occupies only the bottom-right corner, about 15% of the frame. The other 85% stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.
motion: A living cinemagraph desktop wallpaper, locked-off stationary camera, one continuous take, zero cuts. The frame you are given is the picture: their pose, gaze direction, what they are holding and the lighting are already frozen. Their head, face, eyes, neck, arms, and torso stay completely motionless in their exact initial position throughout the entire clip: zero head turning, zero head tilting, zero nodding, zero gaze shifting, zero expression change. Absolute zero bodily movement: they do not turn around, sit down, stand up, reach, or move their hands. The only movement permitted in the entire video is subtle ambient cinemagraph micro-motion: the slow rhythmic rise and fall of the chest from breathing, gentle micro-fluttering of hair tips and fabric edges in gentle air, and outside the window subtle cloud movement or water running down the glass. Everything on the desk stays frozen, whatever they are holding stays square to the camera exactly where it is, and characters on any paper stay sharp and completely still. The clip must form a perfectly seamless loop where the last frame connects back to the first frame with invisible transition.
hold: Stationary tripod camera, zero pan, zero tilt, zero zoom, framing strictly fixed. The subject stays the exact same size, in the exact same place, in the exact same drawing as the source frame, and the open area stays 100% open and static for desktop icons from the first frame to the last. Exposure, brightness, contrast, shadows, and color palette stay completely constant with zero flicker, zero fade, zero lighting pulse, and no sun movement.

scenes.desc: a bright morning through a large window, low sun across the floor
rain running down the glass, everything outside soft and grey
a city at night far below, small lights, quiet
low hills fading into haze, nothing urgent out there

room: Kept things stand on a shelf, on the windowsill, or on the wall.
note_layout: Long shot for the room, but the note is a foreground object: she holds it out toward the camera at full arm length, square to the camera, so it reads large and sharp in the bottom-right of the frame. Everything left of centre and everything above her stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.
idle: standing at the window, doing nothing in particular
